text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I happened upon Vincennes and the others during their dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ...Magnificent. Such a graceful—truly mesmerizing dance.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Thank you. However—I find myself conflicted. I feel as though I need to incorporate a more special stage direction... brand-new choreography.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: Brand-new choreography... you say?

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...I want to project a presence that won't be overshadowed by "that person" sharing the stage with me at the upcoming live.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —My, how admirable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Please, polish your craft to your heart's content. Do cultivate the sort of "splendor" capable of stealing away every gaze.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Only then will dominating the stage provide me with true amusement.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: Phew...! *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ...Vincennes-san. Aren't you perhaps pushing yourself a little too hard—

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: ...I know. But... it is still not enough...!

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: I must master a magnificent dance worthy of a queen—one that will not yield to Gentildonna-san...!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ............ Vincennes-san. Um... may I say something?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: If—I were to compare you to a flower, Vincennes-san.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: —A deep, beautiful blue like the water's surface. A blue rose, symbolizing unwavering "love," "beauty," and the "fulfillment of dreams."

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: I am—such a flower?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me if I speak out of turn. But... I wondered if my knowledge of flower arrangement might be of some reference.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: For example—blue flowers are said to represent dignity and serenity, providing a calm and composed impression.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: If one were to weave those elements together with your natural charm and express them—I believe an elegant and graceful dance would be best suited.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: Yes—just like a truly refined queen.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: ............ Bouquet-san. Would you mind telling me more in detail?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Flowers, is it? An intriguing concept. However—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Do you possess the confidence to bloom so magnificently upon the stage as to eclipse me?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ...Gentil-san is certainly beautiful. Furthermore, you are someone blessed with an immense presence.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: However... precisely because you are there, I believe it will make Vincennes-san appear even more beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you suggesting you will turn me into a mere backdrop?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ...No. Each other's existence... brings out the beauty in the other.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: If I were to compare you to a flower, you would be a noble red rose, harboring a burning passion within.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Vincennes-san is a flower evoking serene grace. Equal in dignity, yet strikingly contrasting in color.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: And—by arranging contrasting beauties side by side, their brilliance is elevated all the more.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
To the same melody—one dances splendidly and boldly.
The other, fluidly and gracefully.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
It should create a beauty like a "bouquet"—
something that could never be born individually.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —My. You are usually so reserved, yet you speak with such conviction.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text: ...This is something I can truly, from the bottom of my heart—believe in.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
When each of their splendors find "harmony"—
I believe there is no beauty more "special" than that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A red rose and a blue rose.
What kind of bouquet will you create by binding them together—
This time, I shall leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text: ...Gentildonna-san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—with Karen Bouquet Doll's help,
the finished dance went on to receive
high acclaim at the actual live performance.
